text:
The useless days are like a crust

of grime on the soul.

There is a slow suffocation that smiles,

that forgets, that keeps quiet.

Who puts these toads on my chest

when I say nothing?

There's an idiot like me walking around,

chatting with people and ghosts,

lying down in the mud and rooting through

the shit of fame.

A snouted pig reciting verses

at family parties, where wise women

talk of love and war,

settle the question of hope.

A pig of the easy world

where deceit wants to pretend it deceives,

while slow acids

bring disgust up to the throat.

There is a man who falls for days and days,

upright, from his face,

and feels deaths and souls

growing in his chest.

A man like me who feels ashamed,

who grows tired,

who doesn't ask because he doesn't ask

or want anything.

What is all this failed tenderness doing here?

Tell it to go away!

translation.title: The Useless Days
